page_title: BOC 1-3 WOL | Bochum v Wolfsburg 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' A cross from a corner kick by Bochum is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
90+4' Mohamed Amoura will be replaced by Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg).
90' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' 1 - 3 Goal! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 1:3.
88' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the left side of the target, but Patrick Drewes pulls off a superb save.
88' We are about to witness a substitution. Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) is replacing Myron Boadu.
88' Peter Zeidler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aliou Balde (Bochum) replacing Ivan Ordets.
88' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is going to take the penalty!
87' The Wolfsburg players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
86' There's a break in play and referee Max Burda must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Wolfsburg using VAR. This could be interesting!
83' That looked a certain handball by Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
82' The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg win a corner kick.

81' What a sweet touch by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) after latching on to a fine pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and unleashes a cannonball towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper makes a brilliant save, pushing the ball onto the post. The linesman makes the right call and Wolfsburg will have a corner.
79' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to make a change. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) replaces Jakub Kaminski.
79' Substitution. Aster Vranckx walks off the pitch and Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.

77' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
75' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Ridle Baku will be replaced by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg).
73' Here comes a substitution. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Tiago Tomas.
72' 1 - 2 Goal! Moritz Broschinski shows great vision to find Myron Boadu (Bochum) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
72' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

72' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bochum will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.

68' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lukas Daschner (Bochum) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Kamil Grabara pulls off a brilliant save. Bochum force a corner. They send men into the box.

67' A neat pass is well received by Lukas Daschner (Bochum), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.

66' Kamil Grabara was forced into action to thwart Myron Boadu (Bochum). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
65' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
62' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) but poses no threat. The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will take a throw-in.

61' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
60' Substitution. Anthony Losilla makes way for Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
60' Substitution. Lukas Daschner (Bochum) on for Dani de Wit.
57' The free kick from long range, taken by Bochum, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
56' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Max Burda and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
56' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
55' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is able to continue to play.
54' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.

49' Excellent touch by Maximilian Wittek (Bochum)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
47' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Max Burda blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle as Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45+4' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) makes a rough challenge and Max Burda blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Wolfsburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
45+3' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) commits a rough challenge and Max Burda blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.

38' Jakov Medic (Bochum) talks out of turn to the referee and subsequently receives a yellow card. His behaviour towards the referee was not friendly. He should be thankful, it could have been much worse!
38' Although Peter Zeidler (Bochum) is just on the bench, Max Burda has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
38' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
37' 0 - 2 GOAL! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) scores in ugly fashion, sending the ball into the net via a miscued scissor kick direct from a lofted ball into the box. It’s 0:2.
37' The linesman points to the corner flag, Wolfsburg are going to take it.

36' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
33' Myron Boadu (Bochum) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the right side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Kamil Grabara.
32' Referee Max Burda sees the trip by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Bochum will take a free kick.
28' Dani de Wit (Bochum) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
27' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
26' Dangerous play by Philipp Hofmann (Bochum). Max Burda blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Wolfsburg.
24' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
21' 0 - 1 Goal Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg)! Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) was put through by Mohamed Amoura and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the left side of the net. 0:1.
19' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Max Burda changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
18' Celebrations by Bochum are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

18' The players claim that Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) handled the ball and it seems they are right. The referee gives a penalty to Bochum after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
17' Max Burda has a clear sight and sees a foul from Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg). Bochum will take a free kick near the side line.
16' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
15' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolfsburg.
14' Felix Passlack (Bochum) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Wolfsburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
14' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
12' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Kamil Grabara to dive and make a save.
12' Max Burda blows for a foul after Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Bochum have a free kick.
12' A dangerous looking corner kick from Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is cleared to safety by the defence.
11' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
6' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
6' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Wolfsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' It looks like Matus Bero (Bochum) saw red with that tackle. Max Burda won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Wolfsburg have a free kick.

4' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
4' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Bochum are awarded a free kick.

2' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Matus Bero (Bochum). Max Burda saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Wolfsburg, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bochum will have the kick-off.
Max Burda got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
